title: Three degC difference sensors stay classless where HA >= 2025.11.0 offers TEMPERATURE_DELTA
claim: ECL110 Displace, ECL110 Effective Displace and Prediction Accuracy publish temperature differences in degC with no device class (3 sensors); Home Assistant 2025.11.0 added SensorDeviceClass.TEMPERATURE_DELTA (measurement), so on any install at or above 2025.11.0 a device class is possible and unused, and a Fahrenheit user sees these deltas unconverted.
mechanism: The rows were left bare deliberately because TEMPERATURE converts a delta as an absolute; the floor in hacs.json (2025.2.0) predates TEMPERATURE_DELTA (absent in core 2025.10.0's sensor/const.py, present from 2025.11.0). The rule asks for device classes where possible; a getattr(SensorDeviceClass, 'TEMPERATURE_DELTA', None) keeps the floor working. Per D10.M2 this is the todo needing an API newer than the floor, with its minimum release.

evidence.unit: sensors in degC with no device class
evidence.machine: local macOS box B2 (orchestrator machine), Python 3.14 venv-ci
evidence.contention_note: shared box, other finder seats running; a count, contention-immune

metric_definition: delta_bare = sensors (via async_setup_entry) whose native unit is degC or K and whose published device class is None
phenomenon_property: Every sensor publishing a temperature difference declares TEMPERATURE_DELTA wherever the running Home Assistant provides it, and none declares TEMPERATURE.
proposed_fix_scope: sensor.py: the three delta sensors take SensorDeviceClass.TEMPERATURE_DELTA when the running core has it (getattr fallback to None at the 2025.2.0 floor)
